messages:
Samir K (support): Heads-up — customer (AcmeSearch) is seeing wildly wrong rerank scores when they send multi-query batches. They say scores look correct for single-query requests but in batches the scores seem shifted and some queries map to other candidates.
Marta L (support): Got the original report and sample payload. They have variable-length candidate lists (0..10 candidates per query). When a query has 0 candidates the following queries' scores appear to slide left.
Samir K (support): Repro steps from customer (copied):
```
POST /v1/rerank/batch
Content-Type: application/json
Authorization: Bearer sk-***
{
  "queries": ["q1","q2","q3"],
  "candidates": [
    ["c1","c2"],
    [],
    ["c3"]
  ]
}
```
Response: scores returned as flat array [0.4, 0.9, 0.1] which they expect to map to [(q1:c1=0.4,q1:c2=0.9), (q2:[]), (q3:c3=0.1)] but instead client saw q3 score applied to q2 slot.
Priya N (eng-ml): Thanks — this looks like an offsets/flattening mismatch. Our API flattens candidates and returns a single scores vector along with an offsets array. Can you paste the real response they got?
Samir K (support): They attached response: 
```
{ "scores": [0.4,0.9,0.1], "candidate_counts": [2,1] }
```
(weirdly candidate_counts is [2,1] instead of [2,0,1])
Marta L (support): They also said sometimes candidate_counts = null in older SDKs. They upgraded and the behavior changed.
eng-oncall-bot: New support ticket created: RERANK-4832, severity P2. Assigned to eng-runtime.
Jorge R (eng-runtime): Looking. If the service drops zero-length lists when computing counts that's a bug. We should keep per-query counts length == queries.length. Any chance client code is merging empty arrays before sending?
Samir K (support): Customer insists payload is as-is. I sanitized and repro locally with a python snippet they provided — I can reproduce. Attaching local curl output.
Marta L (support): Repro snippet from customer: 
```
import requests
req = {"queries":["a","b","c"],"candidates":[["x"],[],["y"]]}
r = requests.post(url,json=req,headers=headers)
print(r.json())
```
Result: `{'scores':[0.75,0.6],'candidate_counts':[1,1]}` -> missing the zero count slot.
Priya N (eng-ml): That confirms server-side flattening drop. Two hypotheses: (A) at flatten step we filter out empty candidate lists and compute counts from the filtered list (bug), or (B) the JSON unmarshaler collapses empty arrays due to a model binding issue. I'll instrument the flattening function to log per-query lengths.
Jorge R (eng-runtime): Quick mitigation: client can add an explicit null placeholder for empty lists, e.g. candidates: [["x"],[null],["y"]] and server should ignore nulls when scoring. But that's ugly. We should fix server to always emit candidate_counts length == queries.length.
Samir K (support): Customer asked if this could be a regression from the v2 rerank API change last month. They rolled back but still hit it.
Priya N (eng-ml): I found the offending commit in flatten-util: we had a `filter(len)` on the nested list before computing offsets to avoid zero-len slices in an internal path. That explains it. Fix: remove filter and compute offsets from original list lengths. Adding unit test for empty candidate arrays.
devops-bot: Deploy pipeline triggered: patch/flat-offset-fix -> staging. CI: 12/14 passing (two flaky tests)
Jorge R (eng-runtime): Can we hotfix staging and ask customer to point to staging for verification? We need a reproducible minimal curl to test.
Marta L (support): Sent staging URL to customer (RERANK-4832). Requested verification and offered temporary workaround (pad with null). Customer is onboard to test.
Samir K (support): Also noted: some SDKs serialized empty lists as `[]` vs omitted property; both should work. We'll add acceptance tests for both serialization styles.
Priya N (eng-ml): Patch landed in PR 7890. Patch notes: "preserve empty candidate lists when computing offsets; return candidate_counts length == queries.length". Rolling to canary now.
eng-oncall-bot: Canary rollout started for patch/flat-offset-fix (10% traffic)
Samir K (support): Customer validated on staging: scores now aligned. They still want a postmortem and ETA for prod fix.
Jorge R (eng-runtime): Plan: monitor canary metrics for 2 hours, then promote to prod if no regressions. ETA ~3h. I'll follow up with status updates.
Marta L (support): Marking ticket RERANK-4832 as "in progress" and will send customer ETA.
Samir K (support): Thanks team. Action items: Priya create unit/regression tests (done), Jorge promote after 2h if green, Marta update customer.
Priya N (eng-ml): Filed follow-up bug to add integration test in e2e harness for variable-length candidate lists.
Jorge R (eng-runtime): Closing loop after prod rollout. Will paste deploy ID and metrics.
devops-bot: Deploy successful to prod: deploy-2026-03-15-321 (rollout 100%). All checks green.
Samir K (support): Customer confirmed prod fix works, closing case. :tada:
